line: R46 registered adaptations / implementation choices (before PROTOCOL_FROZEN_R46.json)

trees.r46f: r42f + tools/r46_patch.py (train_unit) + common R46 section; oracle runner / oracle_truth not copied
trees.r46o: r43o + tools/r46_patch.py (train_unit) + data35 record-pool loading + common R46 section (subset conds)

A.subset: one permutation of the 113287 COCO train images (np.random.default_rng(20261146)); 29k = sorted first 29000, 58k = sorted first 58000 (nested)
A.pool: records whose OBSERVED image (R33 NOISE_LOCK 0.8 map, unchanged) is in the subset: exactly 5 per kept image (the map keeps 5 observed captions per image); 145000 / 290000 records; realized noise 0.8003 / 0.7998 inside the pools
A.interpretation_note: "all 5 captions per kept image, noise map restricted to the subset" implemented on the observed side (the N route trains on observed pairs); restricting by the caption source image instead would change the in-pool noise rate (noisy captions keep an out-of-subset observed image) and was not used
A.sampler: record draws from the pool (data36 draw_main pool argument, as TRUST) -> new record stream; head init / sampler seed unchanged
A.prep: candidates (i2t: subset images over pool captions; t2i: pool captions over subset images), locks (R35 rule over the pool), calibration rebuilt within the pool with the frozen parent H; rows outside the pool keep the R43 rows (never sampled); cache = R43 c80 cache (unchanged, DEV unchanged)
A.joint_prep: byte copy of the R43 c80in_s1001 JOINT prep (same cache), manifest cond renamed

B.init: heads / nulls / student loaded from the round-1 step-8000 checkpoint of the same objective; fresh AdamW; R39 JOINT cosine restarted over the 8000 round-2 updates; sampler stream [1001, 46] (new, both arms)
B.rebuilt: natural top-32 from the round-1 student: full FIT encoded with the round-1 student (parent per-native-batch centring as in training), peer-mean cosine, torch.topk(32); N labels from the observed relation; calibration of the head not re-done (the head continues from round 1; s_H stays the frozen parent native score)
B.continued: identical continuation with the parent (H) tables
B.step0: step-0 DEV two-stage ranks (i2t, t2i) == round-1 step-8000 ranks exactly and rsum equal (replaces the native-H step-0 check and the R39 student-vs-cache check)
B.gpu_pin: B jobs pinned to the round-1 GPU type (Flickr R39 / R41-C units: L40S; COCO R43-A units: RTX6000PRO) so the step-0 rank equality is not broken by kernel differences
B.secondary_readout: round-2 student own top-100 two-stage DEV: post-hoc tool on the final checkpoints (zero training), not in the trainer

checks.gpu_smoke: sbatch/r46_smoke.sbatch + tools/r46_smoke_check.py (gate mode, 20 updates per unit, readouts 0 / 20); GPU_GATE.json written at freeze from GPU_SMOKE_R46.json
